splendour, beauty, loveliness, VS.; ŚBr. &c.

pleasure, delight, liking, wish, desire, VS.; MBh.
pl. N. of a partic. class of Apsarasas, VP.

liking, taste, relish, pleasure, appetite, zest, AV. &c. &c. (ifc. taking pleasure in, desirous of, longing for; with loc., प्रति inf. or comp.; रुचिं-√ दा or रुचये-√ भू, to please; रुचिम् आ-√ वह्, with dat., to excite a desire for; रुच्या or स्व-रुच्या, at pleasure, at will)

pleasant, agreeable, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; MBh.
sweet, delicate, dainty, Uṇ. iv, 185, Sch.
sharpened (as appetite), W.
digested, ib.
रुचित॑ n. an exclamation used at a Śraddha, Mn. iii, 254.
